caption: The drawing features a wooden cabinet composed of two main sections, both constructed from light brown wood with visible grain patterns. The upper section of the cabinet includes three vertically-oriented rectangular doors, with the leftmost door slightly ajar, revealing empty shelving inside. Each door is equipped with metal hinges and round brass-colored knobs. Below this is a drop-front writing surface, which is shown open and supported by two pull-out braces on each side. Inside the compartment behind the drop-front are several small cubbyholes and three small drawers, each with a round knob. The lower section of the cabinet consists of two large doors with metal hinges and matching round knobs, enclosing additional storage space. The entire cabinet stands on four short, slightly splayed legs, elevating it above the floor. There are no other objects in the drawing, and the background is plain with a light beige tint.
title: Shaker Secretary
